evidence: independent run of `npm test` passed (1264 passed)

[model] compileMountPath() only modifies paths matching /^\/{2,}$/ (all-slashes with 2+ occurrences); single '/' doesn't match and is returned unchanged; all other paths (strings, RegExp) are returned unchanged; all 1264 existing tests pass proving backward compatibility.
